replay.title: Request a new send attempt
replay.guidance: Requeues an eligible exhausted delivery. Previous attempts remain counted. The Gateway checks eligibility again; acceptance confirms requeueing, and subsequent sending has its own outcome.
replay.recoveryGuidance: This checks the previous request. Its outcome can be recovered even when a new send attempt is unavailable.

blocked.permission: Requesting a new send attempt requires the platform-admin role.
blocked.state: Only exhausted deliveries can be queued for a new send attempt.
blocked.connector: The connector must be active before a new send attempt can be requested.
blocked.payloadMissing: The original payload is no longer available.
blocked.payloadExpired: The original payload retention period has expired.
blocked.payloadUnknown: The payload retention deadline cannot be verified.
blocked.updating: Updating delivery eligibility. Wait for the current read to complete.
blocked.deliveryMissing: The Gateway could not find this delivery.
blocked.payloadUnavailable: The Gateway reports that the original payload is missing or its retention has expired.
blocked.readFailed: Delivery eligibility could not be refreshed. Retry the detail read before requesting a new send attempt.

replay.inProgress: Replay command {{commandId}} is already in progress.
replay.replayedExplanation: The delivery was requeued. Its current status and attempt history show the outcome of subsequent sends.
replay.inProgressExplanation: The Gateway has registered this command. Its result and the delivery outcome still need to be confirmed.
replay.uncertain: Outcome unconfirmed. The Gateway may already have accepted this command. Retry the same request to recover its result; the reason and command identity will be preserved.
replay.pending: Waiting for the Gateway response. Closing this dialog does not cancel the request.
replay.pendingRequests: Replay requests awaiting a Gateway response: {{count}}. Closing the dialog, navigating within the console, or changing the token does not cancel them. Reloading or leaving the console loses this local tracking.

systemMap.title: System Map
systemMap.description: The implemented integration topology and its operational boundaries. This is architecture reference material, not live telemetry.

source.role: Represents marketplace, partner and ERP systems that own the original order data.
source.interfaces: Signed webhooks can enter through the gateway; canonical HTTP order commands can enter the core directly.

gateway.role: Protects the core from provider-specific protocols and preserves recoverable delivery state.
gateway.interfaces: Receives signed webhooks, polls ERP_B pages and sends normalized HTTP commands to the Integration Core.

core.role: Owns canonical order validation, idempotency, the workflow and the transactional outbox.
core.interfaces: Exposes canonical and operator HTTP APIs, persists core state and publishes canonical events through the outbox.

events.role: Separates durable event publication from asynchronous downstream processing.
events.interfaces: Receives canonical order events from the core outbox and delivers them to consumer groups through the Kafka API.

processor.role: Groups the Core's idempotent order-processing and optional search-projection consumers.
processor.interfaces: Consumes OrderReceived.v1 into Core PostgreSQL and OrderReady.v2 into OpenSearch when the projection is enabled.

gatewayStorage.role: Makes provider delivery and polling recovery durable across gateway restarts.
gatewayStorage.interfaces: Used only by Connector Gateway for delivery attempts, page checkpoints and recovery scheduling.

coreStorage.role: Is the transactional system of record for canonical orders and their workflow.
coreStorage.interfaces: Used by the Integration Core and processing consumer for orders, timeline, outbox and processing state.

search.role: Provides a rebuildable read model for operational order search without becoming the system of record.
search.interfaces: Receives OrderReady.v2 projections from its dedicated consumer; search requests remain behind the Integration Core API.

console.role: Gives operators a controlled interface for orders, deliveries, recovery, simulations, flow evidence and architecture reference.
console.interfaces: Calls the Integration Core and Connector Gateway HTTP APIs; it does not connect directly to PostgreSQL, Redpanda or OpenSearch.

simulator.role: Supplies deterministic local provider behavior for connector development and acceptance evidence.
simulator.interfaces: Exposes ERP_B fixture pages that the Connector Gateway polls in the local compose profile.

observability.role: Collects and presents runtime health, throughput and recovery signals without owning business state.
observability.interfaces: Prometheus scrapes the Core and Gateway metrics endpoints; Grafana reads from Prometheus.
